nonOperationalMasks.description:
Array of rules indicating the time period when {@link ReliabilityAsset} was non-operational
{@link Triple} includes {@link Sensor}, operator (e.g. '>'), and value for the rule.

preNonOperationalMaskPeriod.description:
A {@link Period} of time before each non operational time period (as defined by {@link #nonOperationalMasks})
to exclude {@link Sensor} data for training.

postNonOperationalTrainingMaskPeriod.description:
A {@link Period} of time after each non operational time period (as defined by {@link #nonOperationalMasks})
to exclude {@link Sensor} data for training. This does not apply to inference.

postNonOperationalInferenceMaskPeriod.description:
A {@link Period} of time after each non operational time period (as defined by {@link #nonOperationalMasks})
to exclude {@link Sensor} data for training. This does not apply to inference.

preEventMaskPeriod.description: A {@link Period} of time before each [event](ReliabilityAssetEvent) to exclude {@link Sensor} data for training.

postEventMaskPeriod.description: A {@link Period} of time after each [event](ReliabilityAssetEvent) to exclude {@link Sensor} data for training and inference.

dateRangeMaskTimeRanges.description: {@link TimeRange}s to exclude {@Sensor} data from training data.

trainingRuleMasks.description:
Array of rules indicating the time periods to exclude {@link Sensor} data from training data.
{@link Triple} includes {@link Sensor}, operator (e.g. '>'), and value for the rule.

inferenceRuleMasks.description:
Array of rules indicating the time periods to exclude {@link Sensor} data from inference data.
{@link Triple} includes {@link Sensor}, operator (e.g. '>'), and value for the rule.

nonOperationalMasksExpression.description: String of rules indicating the time period when {@link ReliabilityAsset} was non-operational

trainingRuleMasksExpression.description: String of rules indicating the time periods to exclude {@link Sensor} data from training data.

inferenceRuleMasksExpression.description: String of rules indicating the time periods to exclude {@link Sensor} data from inference data.

flatlineThreshold.description: The flatline sensor data threshold to use for the Data Preparation Job

missingDataThreshold.description: The missing sensor data threshold to use for the Data Preparation Job

windowStart.description: Start {@link datetime} of window for {@link Sensor} data utilized in the dataset.

windowEnd.description: End {@link datetime} of window for {@link Sensor} data utilized in the dataset.

trainingPercentage.description: The percentage of the dataset used for training.

trainStart.description: Start Date of the dataset used for training.

trainEnd.description: End Date of the dataset used for training.

validStart.description: Start Date of the dataset used for Validating.

validEnd.description: End Date of the dataset used for Validating.

trainingSubset.description: The subset of the dataset to use for training.

interval.description: The data {@link Interval} to analyze the data of the {@link Sensor}.

numAssets.description:
Metadata indicating the number of {@link ReliabilityAsset}s to run data preparation on.
This field is not set by the user.

targetAssets.description:
The assets that we want to run data preparation on. Used to filter {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationJob}
by asset.

includeSensors.description:
Sensors to include in the data preparation run.
Note: this field is metadata that is set automatically during
{@link BulkModelSetupUiSettings#startBulkModelSetup}, not by the user.

excludeSensors.description:
Sensors to exclude from the data preparation run.
Note: this field is metadata that is set automatically during
{@link BulkModelSetupUiSettings#startBulkModelSetup}, not by the user.

variance.description: Variance value used to filter {@link SensorDataReport}

project.description: Stores the id of the {@link MlProject} that the user selected to create the new dataset

trainingDatasetTimeRanges.description: The date time ranges selected by the user for training

validateDatasetTimeRanges.description: The date time ranges selected by the user for validation

splitByPercentage.description: The selected split type, can be either by percentage or by time ranges.

extraTimeRangeMasks.description:
Masks created when {@link ReliabilityDataPreparationUiBaseSettings#splitByPercentage} is
set to `false`. This field includes the unselected time ranges, which will be handled as
`mask_AdHocTraining` type masks.

runName.description: The name to use for the Data Preparation Run

assetId.description: The {@link ReliabilityAsset} id to run data prep on.

selectedSensorDataReportsFilter.description: The filter that represents all the selected sensor data reports.

excludedSensorDataReportsFilter.description: The filter that represents all the excluded sensor data reports.

manuallyExcludedSensors.description: Array of {@link SensorDataReport#id}s manually excluded in data preparation.

manuallyIncludedSensors.description: Array of {@link SensorDataReport#id}s manually included in data preparation.

additionalSensors.description: Array of additional {@link Sensor#id}s that have to be included in the dataset preparation.

additionalRasrs.description: Array of additional {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorRelation#id}s that have to be included in the dataset preparation.

name: ReliabilityDataPreparationUiSettings
